formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P12-R3 — Prospective Soft Opportunity-Matching Constitution, 2×2 Action-Opportunity Total-Variation Geometry, Radius/Kernel Common-Support Recovery, Approximation-Error Calibration, Outcome-Blind Balance Selection, Fresh↔Legacy Transport, Residual LB7 Alignment Sensitivity, Negative-Control Geometry & Partial-Identification Audit

structural_representation.primitive: exact 2x2 action-opportunity table derived from K,D,L
structural_representation.distance: total-variation distance between 4-cell action-count distributions = L1(cell-count difference)/(2*18)
structural_representation.interpretation: distance 1/18 corresponds to one unit of action mass transferred between opportunity categories

analysis_population.eligibility: same face-next, non-G1, phase1_lb in {6,7,8}, low-overlap-support-positive population as canonical P12/R1/R2
analysis_population.exact_within_solve_progress_control: normalized progress quintile must match exactly

support_metrics: eligible solve count with positive target and comparator matching mass
structural_selection_stage.selection_rule: among candidates passing all gates, select lowest maximum ancestry mean-distance units; ties by greater minimum ancestry eligible-solve fraction; then candidate order listed above

matching_semantics.hard_radius: within solve×progress quintile, each target state is compared with all comparator states within radius; comparator contribution is uniform over admitted states
matching_semantics.nearest_neighbor: within solve×progress quintile, use up to k nearest comparator states; ties at the kth distance are all retained with equal distance-level normalization
matching_semantics.exponential_kernel: within solve×progress quintile, all comparator states receive weight exp(-distance/tau), normalized within target state
matching_semantics.target_aggregation: each target state contributes one target excess minus its weighted comparator excess; solve is the independent unit via equal-weight mean across its eligible target states

behavioral_stage.primary: fresh solve-level mean lb7 minus softly matched lb6/8 low-overlap excess

adjudication.support_limited: selected candidate yields fewer than 20 fresh eligible solves at behavioral stage
adjudication.structural_opportunity_sufficient: otherwise fresh residual changes sign or abs(residual) <= 0.5 * abs(0.056231231231231235)
adjudication.residual_alignment: otherwise fresh residual remains positive and abs(residual) > 0.5 * abs(0.056231231231231235)

negative_controls.shell_label_permutation: within solve×progress quintile, deterministically rotate lb labels among eligible states while preserving structural tables and state counts; report whether selected-family attenuation is specific to true lb7 targeting
negative_controls.behavior_usage: negative-control family is evaluated only after primary structural selection is frozen and cannot alter selected candidate

inference_boundary: Soft matching relaxes exact structural identity and therefore supports partial, not exact, structural adjustment.
Approximation budgets are expressed in action-category mass units and fixed before behavioral residuals are opened.
Attenuation after soft matching is descriptive mediation evidence, not causal identification.
No TS/PDB coordinate or selected soft-match family is a latent cognitive state.
Human-contact and mechanism-promotion gates remain closed.
